Problem Statement:
Given a number N followed by N integers, find the second smallest element in the list. If there is no second smallest (i.e., all elements are the same or only one element), print -1. 
Input Description:
First line: an integer N (1
≤ N
≤ 100000)
Second line: N space-separated integers 
Output Description:
Print the second smallest element if it exists
Otherwise, print -1 
Sample Input:
5
1 2 3 4 5 
Sample Output:
2
